Dear [Canon Warburton ](../persons.html#1466)
I will send £1 for dear Bishop [Harold Browne](../persons.html#213)’s memorial but I am away now from cheque books. I go home on Saturday however having partly come to hear the history of the [wonderful surprises](../others.html#225) of Aug 11th with which the Moberly’s had much to do.[^1]
[Mrs Wordsworth ](../persons.html#1569)is very cheerful, I hope to see her this afternoon[^2]
Yours very truly

C M Yonge

[^1]: The celebration of her 70th birthday described by Coleridge, [Life](../others.html#40), 281-2, and Battiscombe, [Charlotte Mary Yonge](../others.html#17), 159.

Both these writers give this birthday as the 13 August, although CMY in her autobiographical writings always gives it as the 11 August.

[^2]: Susan Esther (Coxe) Wordsworth (1841/2-1894), wife of John Wordsworth, Bishop of Salisbury. CMY was staying in the Close at Salisbury with Alice Moberly, the daughter of his predecessor as bishop.
